paragraphs.en: At the first community meeting, everyone agreed that the new center should serve the whole population. Agreement became harder when a young parent asked whether a private room could be reserved for feeding a baby. A senior member wanted space for quiet conversation, while a boy hoped for a place to play. Each person had a reasonable request, but the planning team had only one building. The challenge was to give a diverse group a common place without pretending that every individual needed the same thing.
paragraphs.zh: 第一次社区会议上，大家都同意新中心应该服务所有居民。但当一位年轻家长提出为喂养婴儿预留独立房间时，意见开始分歧。一位年长成员希望有安静聊天的空间，一个男孩则想要玩耍的地方。每个人的要求都合理，但筹划团队只有一栋楼。难题在于为多样的人群提供共同空间，同时不假装每个人的需求都一样。

paragraphs.en: The architect avoided designing around an imagined average adult. A mother carrying a child, a father recovering from surgery, and a girl using a wheelchair each tested the entrance. A low handrail gave a small hand firm support and let a kid move confidently; a level entrance welcomed people arriving on foot as well as those using a wheelchair. A chair near the doorway offered a place to rest. Good design respected the body before it impressed the eye. It also protected dignity: someone should not have to announce a medical condition merely to enter a public building.
paragraphs.zh: 建筑师没有围绕想象中的普通成年人来设计。抱着孩子的母亲、术后康复的父亲，以及坐轮椅的女孩，都测试了入口。低扶手为小手提供稳固支撑，让孩子能自信地移动；无台阶入口方便步行者，也方便轮椅使用者。门边的椅子让人可以稍作休息。好的设计先尊重身体的实际需求，再追求视觉效果，也保护人的尊严：进入公共建筑，不应以公开自己的病情为前提。

paragraphs.en: An argument about the center’s name revealed a deeper problem. A retired husband and wife suggested honoring a well-known donor, whose public image was admirable. Others preferred a local teacher with a generous character but little social status. The head of the committee asked residents to examine the values behind their preference. Would the most important feature of the center be prestige or participation? A male student and a female researcher worked together on interviews, allowing residents to speak for themselves rather than be represented by assumptions.
paragraphs.zh: 围绕中心名称的争论揭示了更深层的问题。一对退休夫妇建议纪念一位公众形象出色的知名捐赠者。另一些人更倾向于纪念一位待人慷慨、却没有显赫地位的当地教师。委员会负责人请居民思考自己的偏好反映了什么价值：中心最重要的特征究竟是名望，还是参与？一名男学生和一名女研究人员一起开展访谈，让居民自己表达，而不是由外界的想象来代言。

paragraphs.en: The interviews showed that friendship mattered as much as equipment. One couple had moved from another city and missed having a familiar face nearby. A teenager wanted advice from a peer who shared a similar background. A retired engineer said that learning a new skill kept his brain active and strengthened his sense of self. Society often praises independence, yet his story suggested that confidence can grow through mutual support. The center therefore offered shared activities without requiring anyone to disclose family difficulties.
paragraphs.zh: 访谈表明，友谊与设施同样重要。一对从外地搬来的伴侣想念身边有熟悉面孔的感觉。一名青少年希望得到具有相似背景的同龄人的建议。退休工程师说，学习新技能让头脑保持活跃，也加强了自我认同。社会经常赞扬独立，但他的经历表明，自信也可以从相互支持中成长。因此，中心安排了共同活动，又不要求任何人公开家庭困境。

paragraphs.en: On opening day, a friend of the architect remarked that the building had a generous heart. The phrase was sentimental, but it captured the result. Members of every generation could find a reason to stay. A visitor could read alone or join a project, introduce himself or simply observe. “Make yourself comfortable,” said the volunteer at the door. The invitation worked because belonging was built into ordinary details, rather than left to a slogan on the wall. The committee would review complaints after three months, recognizing that even an inclusive opening could miss needs that emerged only after people had used the space in their own ways.
paragraphs.zh: 开放当天，建筑师的一位朋友说这栋建筑有一颗宽厚的心。这个说法有些感性，却准确概括了成果。每个年龄段的居民都能找到留下来的理由。访客可以独自阅读，也可以参与项目；可以自我介绍，也可以只在一旁观察。门口的志愿者说：“请自在一点。”这句话之所以有效，是因为归属感已经融入日常细节，而不是停留在墙上的标语里。委员会将在三个月后检查反馈，因为即便开放时已充分考虑包容，仍可能遗漏只有居民实际使用场所后才显现的需求。
